jobs.description:
Claims Complex Casualty Adjuster

Job Summary
The Claims Complex Casualty Adjuster handles complex claims involving material damage, property, and/or liability lines of insurance written by the Interinsurance Exchange in compliance with all regulatory and statutory requirements. The primary functions include liability investigation, coverage evaluation, negotiation strategies and claims resolution of complex claims. Employs discretion and independent judgment to ensure compliance with state and federal law, and with established company, technical, and customer service best practices. Under limited supervision, works within specific limits of authority to resolve claims.

Job Duties

  • Conduct phone and/or field investigations to determine liability and damages. Identify and obtain statements from insureds, claimants and witnesses. May attend and participate in legal proceedings.
  • Communicate and interact with a variety of individuals including insureds and claimants. Explain benefits, coverages, fault and claims process either verbally or in writing which complies with regulatory and statutory requirements. Recognize and appropriately address complex coverage and subrogation issues.
  • Evaluate and determine claim values upon receipt and assessment of property, bodily injury and liability data.
  • Negotiate within settlement authority with insureds and claimants to resolve their first and third-party claims.
  • Control expenses for areas of responsibility.
  • Handle administrative functions, update database production reports, document and update claim files via company systems, i.e. CACS, HUON, HOC, GUIDEWIRE, etc.
  • Verify and interpret/resolve coverage by gathering necessary information to ensure policy applicability. Coordinate with internal and external departments as required.
  • Mentor other adjusters, assisting them with increasing understanding of adjudicating complex claims.
  • Respond quickly to customer needs and problems.
  • Independently resolve claim exposures within level of authority.

Qualifications

  • Bachelors Equivalent combination of education and experience Preferred
  • 7-9 years Property, Auto, Casualty or relevant claims experience. Required
  • 10+ years Prior claims experience. Preferred
  • Comprehensive knowledge of claims administration best practices and procedures.
  • Advanced knowledge of insurance, fault assessment, negligence and subrogation principles.
  • Comprehensive understanding of building and vehicle repair procedures and third-party liability issues.
  • Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Office suite, general computer software and claims software.
  • Advanced organization and planning recognition skills required.
  • Advanced oral and written communication skills required.
  • Advanced interpersonal skills required.
  • Advanced leadership skills among peers required.
  • Exhibit proficiency and understanding of medical terminology and causality.
  • Valid Driver's License, acceptable Department of Motor Vehicles record and minimum liability insurance - Issued by State Required
  • Chartered Property Casualty Underwriter - Insurance Institute of America Preferred
  • Associate in Claims - Insurance Institute of America Preferred
  • An insurance/claims adjuster license may be required for claims administration in specific states. Preferred

Travel Requirements

  • Occasional travel to business meetings or conferences.

The starting pay range for this position is:

$44.66 - $59.47

Additionally, for full time positions, you will be eligible to participate in our incentive program based upon the achievement of organization, team and personal performance.

.

travel, entertainment, services and more!)

jobs.title: Grid Protection Engineer
jobs.excerpt: Ready to make a difference?  ICF is seeking a Senior Grid Protection Engineer to support the development of protective relay settings for high-voltage substation projects ranging from 12 kV through 500 kV.
jobs.description:
Ready to make a difference?


ICF is seeking a Senior Grid Protection Engineer to support the development of protective relay settings for high-voltage substation projects ranging from 12 kV through 500 kV.


You will perform short-circuit and protection studies, develop relay settings and calculation packages, review protection and control designs, and provide technical support during implementation. You will work closely with engineers, designers, project managers, and utility clients to deliver reliable, accurate, and high-quality protection solutions.

We are a relentlessly client-focused team reimagining, redesigning, and re-engineering how electric utilities address industry challenges. We are looking for motivated and innovative professionals who want to strengthen grid reliability while continuing to grow their technical expertise.


Why you will love working here:

  • Quality of life: Flexible workplace arrangements and a strong focus on work-life balance
  • Investment in you: Tuition reimbursement, professional development resources, 401(k) matching, and an Employee Stock Purchase Plan
  • Investment in the community: Donation matching and volunteer opportunities
  • And many more benefits. Ask your recruiter for additional details.

What you will be doing:

  • Perform short-circuit model reviews and identify data or modeling issues that may affect protection studies.
  • Conduct short-circuit and protection coordination studies using software such as CAPE/Gridscale X Advanced Protection Assessment, ASPEN OneLiner, CYME, or similar power-system analysis tools.
  • Develop and review calculation packages used to determine protective relay settings and coordination requirements.
  • Configure settings files for microprocessor-based protective relays.
  • Review protection and control design packages to confirm that relay settings, logic, schematics, and design intent are accurately aligned.
  • Review relay logic and control schemes for proper implementation of protection philosophies.
  • Support the development of NERC PRC compliance documentation, including calculations, reports, and supporting technical records.
  • Coordinate with protection and control engineers, substation designers, project managers, and client representatives to resolve technical questions and support project delivery.
  • Provide remote technical support to relay test engineers and field personnel during the installation, testing, and commissioning of relay settings.
  • Perform quality-control checks on technical calculations, relay settings, and project documentation.
  • Maintain organized and accurate project files in accordance with client and company standards.
  • Continue developing knowledge of protective relaying, utility standards, industry practices, and emerging grid technologies.
  • Manage assigned work independently while meeting project schedules, quality expectations, and client requirements.
  • Perform technical and quality reviews of protection studies, relay settings, calculations, and documentation prepared by other engineers.
  • Support the development of newer and less-experienced engineers through technical guidance, training, mentorship, and assistance with project execution and engineering workflows.

What we need you to have (minimum qualifications):

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a closely related engineering discipline.
  • 5+ years of professional experience in protective relaying, relay settings development, power-system protection, substation protection and control, or a closely related area.
  • Experience performing short-circuit studies, protection coordination studies, or relay-setting calculations.
  • Experience using at least one power-system analysis or protection software platform, such as CAPE/Gridscale X, ASPEN OneLiner, CYME, ETAP, or similar software.
  • Understanding of electric power systems, including substations, transmission or distribution systems, fault analysis, and protective relay applications.
  • Ability to read and interpret protection and control drawings, including one-line diagrams, AC/DC schematics, and relay logic diagrams.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel and Word.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and technical documentation skills.
  • Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to engineering team members, clients, field personnel, and nontechnical stakeholders.
  • Ability to manage multiple assignments, work independently in a remote environment, and meet project deadlines.

What we would like you to have (preferred qualifications):

  • Experience with developing settings for Schweitzer Engineering Laboratories (SEL) protective relays.
  • Experience creating or reviewing relay logic, protection philosophies, coordination curves, and settings calculation reports.
  • Experience supporting protection systems for high-voltage substations ranging from 12 kV through 500 kV.
  • Knowledge of transmission and distribution protection applications, including line, transformer, bus, breaker-failure, capacitor-bank, or feeder protection.
  • Familiarity with applicable NERC PRC standards, utility protection practices, and relevant IEEE standards.
  • Experience supporting relay testing, commissioning, or field implementation activities.
  • Experience using programming, scripting, spreadsheet automation, or other tools to improve engineering calculations and workflows.
  • Engineer-in-Training certification or progress toward professional engineering licensure.
  • Previous experience working for an electric utility, engineering consulting firm, relay manufacturer, or power-delivery organization.
  • Experience leveraging AI, automation, or other emerging digital tools to improve engineering workflows, increase efficiency, and enhance the quality and consistency of technical deliverables.

#GEA25

We can only solve the world's toughest challenges by building a workplace that allows everyone to thrive. We are an equal opportunity employer. jobs.description:
Become a part of our caring community

The Clinical Innovation Delivery Principal leads execution of priority Clinical Innovation initiatives by coordinating cross-functional and regional teams, monitoring performance, and driving accountability for implementation. Working independently in a highly matrixed environment, this role partners across Clinical, Pharmacy, Stars, Medicare Risk Adjustment, Operations, and Regional teams to advance initiative outcomes and resolve execution barriers.

Serving as a strategic integrator, the Principal translates enterprise priorities into coordinated delivery. Early responsibilities include establishing portfolio operating mechanisms, governance processes, delivery plans, leading performance metrics, and issue-resolution pathways; aligning stakeholders on priorities, ownership, dependencies, and tradeoffs; and advising senior leaders on decisions required to advance execution. As the function matures, the Principal will lead high-visibility enterprise initiatives from concept through implementation, adoption, and value realization.

Success in this role requires a leader who thrives in ambiguous and evolving environments, creates structure where no established playbook exists, and moves fluidly between enterprise strategy and operational detail. The successful candidate mobilizes diverse partners, balances time, energy, and resources across a changing portfolio of competing priorities, and uses sound judgment, structured problem solving, executive presence, and influence without direct authority to establish accountability, resolve barriers, and deliver measurable, sustainable results. The Principal builds and institutionalizes new capabilities within accountable business functions, then redirects focus to the enterprise’s next highest-value opportunity.

Responsibilities

Drive Initiative Execution

  • Coordinate implementation of high-priority Clinical Innovation initiatives.
  • Develop and manage delivery plans, milestones, risks, and dependencies.
  • Identify barriers to execution and facilitate resolution with key stakeholders.

Partner with Regional and Enterprise Teams

  • Work with regional and functional leaders to support successful implementation of initiatives.
  • Align stakeholders on priorities, roles, and timelines.
  • Share leading practices and lessons learned across Regions.

Support Governance and Decision-Making

  • Prepare materials, insights, and recommendations for leadership discussions.
  • Facilitate cross-functional meetings to support decision-making and issue resolution.
  • Track commitments, actions, and outcomes through completion.

Monitor Performance and Outcomes

  • Maintain dashboards and reporting to track initiative performance and progress.
  • Analyze results and identify opportunities to improve implementation and adoption.
  • Communicate key risks, insights, and outcomes to leadership.


Use your skills to make an impact

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree
  • 10 or more years of experience in healthcare operations, program delivery, performance improvement, business operations and/or consulting
  • 5 or more years leading large-scale cross-functional initiatives
  • Demonstrated success leading complex programs and driving measurable business results.
  • Proven ability to independently influence senior leaders and executive stakeholders, align competing priorities, and drive decisions and outcomes in a highly matrixed organization without direct authority.
  • Strong analytical, operational, and problem-solving skills.

In addition to having a positive impact on the people and communities we serve, associates benefit from significant professional opportunities, career advancement, training and competitive wages.

Offering competitive salaries and comprehensive benefits packages to include tuition reimbursement, 401-K match, pet and legal insurance.

A LITTLE BIT ABOUT FCS

Since 1984, Florida Cancer Specialists & Research Institute & Research Institute (FCS) has built a national reputation for excellence. With over 250 physicians, 220 nurse practitioners and physician assistants and nearly 100 locations in our network. Utilizing innovative clinical research, cutting-edge technologies, and advanced treatments, we are committed to providing world-class cancer care. We are recognized by the American Society of Clinical Oncology (ASCO) with a national Clinical Trials Participation Award, FCS offers patients access to more clinical trials than any private oncology practice in Florida. Our patients have access to ground-breaking therapies, in a community setting, and may participate in national clinical research studies of drugs and treatment protocols. In the past five years, the majority of new cancer drugs approved for use in the U.S. were studied in clinical trials with FCS participation prior to approval.

Through our partnership with Sarah Cannon, we are one of the largest clinical research organizations in the United States. Often, FCS leads the nation in initiating research studies and offering ground-breaking new therapies to patients.

Come join us today!

PRIMARY TASKS AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • M&A and CAPEX Financial Leadership
    • Serve as the finance subject matter expert for FCS’s M&A efforts and CAPEX projects in partnership with business development, facilities and operations leadership.
    • Own the analytical framework for measuring and interpreting financial performance of acquisitions & CAPEX projects in progress and post go-live, tracking business case vs. actuals.
    • Participate in integration planning to monitor expenses relative to approved business cases & update models to provide timely visibility into changing expectations.
    • Develop and refine transparent, repeatable reporting and models that explain performance and support performance evaluation vs. business cases.
  • Forecasting, Budgeting, and Planning Support
    • Lead forecasting, budgeting, and planning activities related to the M&A pipeline, CAPEX projects, and enterprise capital budget allocation.
    • Build models that support annual planning cycles, in-year forecasts, and scenario analysis.
    • Partner with stakeholders to ensure assumptions are well-supported, documented, and aligned to business realities.
  • Executive Decision Support and Reporting
    • In collaboration with cross-functional teams, build business cases in support of M&A and CAPEX projects in support of FCS’s growth
    • Deliver concise, executive-ready reporting packages evaluating performance vs. business case expectations, explain results, and highlight risks and opportunities.
    • Build “so what” insights that help leadership understand what is changing, why it matters, and what actions may improve outcomes.
    • Tailor analyses for different leadership audiences.
  • Analytical and Strategic Support
    • Support the full range of analytical, reporting, and strategic needs in support of FCS’s growth.
    • Contribute to ad hoc analyses, business cases, profitability reviews, strategic planning efforts, and leadership requests.
    • Help prioritize opportunities to improve financial performance.
    • Ensure outputs are auditable and easy for stakeholders to interpret.
  • Continuous Improvement and Cross-Functional Collaboration
    • Partner across finance, operations, and practice leadership to identify opportunities for process improvement and stronger performance management – in particular as it relates to post go-live &A and CAPEX project postmortems.
    • Recommend enhancements to underwriting, analytical and integration approaches to improve decision support and outcomes over time.

EDUCATION/CERTIFICATIONS & LICENSES:

  • Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree (MBA, MS or similar) in finance, analytics or related field preferred.
  • CFA a plus.

EXPERIENCE:

  • 7+ years of progressive experience in M&A, corporate development, PE, FP&A, financial modeling, or analytics, with a demonstrated track record of leading complex transactions, integrations and CAPEX initiatives in a large, matrixed organization.
  • Experience collaborating with C-suite executives & across multiple functions to affect solutions.
  • Excellent financial modeling & problem-solving skills.
  • Executive presence and experience with presentations to various leadership levels.
  • Ability to provide strategic recommendations and influence stakeholders to make decisions.

CORE COMPETENCIES, KNOWLEDGE/SKILLS/ABILITIES:

  • Experience evaluating and modeling M&A transactions and capital projects
  • Deep expertise in advanced analytics, statistical modeling, and AI/ML applications for forecasting. Mastery of Excel, Sigma/Power BI/Tableau, and financial systems (e.g., Workday, SAP, Oracle, Hyperion).
  • Financial systems experience with ability to reconcile information from multiple sources.
  • Motivated self-starter that is well organized, dependable, efficient and results-oriented.
  • Strong time management and organization skills with flexibility to work in a fast-paced and changing work environment.

VALUES:

  • Patient First – Keeping the patient at the center of everything we do
  • Accountability – Taking responsibility for our actions
  • Commitment & Care – Upholding FCS vision through every action
  • Team – Working together, one team, one mission

Expectations for all Employees

Every FCS employee is expected to regularly conduct themselves in a professional and respectful manner, to comply with all labor laws, workplace policy and workplace practices. Employees are expected to bring issues of any forms of workplace harassment, discrimination or other potential improprieties to the attention of their management or the human resources department.


#FCS-REV

SCREENINGS – Background and drug screens

Safeguarding our patients and each other is an important part of how we deliver the best care possible to the communities we serve. All offers of employment at Florida Cancer Specialists & Research Institute are contingent upon clear results of a thorough background screening. Additionally, as a condition of employment, FCS requires all new hires to receive various vaccinations, including the influenza vaccine, barring an approved exemption. In addition, FCS is a drug-free workplace, and all new hires will be subject to drug testing. Medical Marijuana cards are not recognized.

jobs.title: Head of Technical Content
jobs.excerpt: About Us Tameson is a global e-commerce store helping small and medium businesses source industrial components online.
jobs.description:
About Us

Tameson is a global e-commerce store helping small and medium businesses source industrial components online. We are looking for a Head of Technical Content to take end-to-end ownership of our technical presence.

About the Role

This is not a standard copywriting role or strategist role. We want someone with an engineering mind and a marketing insight, someone who figures things out, builds things, and ships them without waiting to be told. Someone who understands who our customers are: engineers and procurement teams at small and medium businesses sourcing industrial components, and what they need to make a confident purchase decision. If you are excited about building AI-driven content pipelines, that matters more than a long track record.

You will own technical content from strategy to publication, including its technical accuracy. Your output shapes how engineers find Tameson, how the site ranks, and whether visitors convert into buyers. You work closely with our Product and Operations teams to extract technical knowledge and turn it into content competitors cannot replicate.

A Flavor of What You’d Work On

  • Audit our solenoid valve categories, identify what is missing or underperforming, and decide whether the fix is a selection guide, a page restructure, JSON-LD, or additional supporting content. Build it and analyze performance.

  • Take our internal valve performance test data and turn it into a content series: articles, comparison tables, video scripts, email campaigns, social posts. Build assets from proprietary data that competitors cannot replicate.

  • Work with industry partners to reach their communities through forums, sponsored placements, or native articles on their platforms.

  • Analyze pages that get traffic but do not convert. Investigate whether it is a traffic quality, content quality, or conversion issue, implement a fix, and track the result against sales.

  • Get up to speed on a product you know little about, write a buyer guide, fact-check it against manufacturer datasheets, and publish it without a technical reviewer.

Key Outcomes & Responsibilities

  • End-to-End Ownership: You will identify gaps in our content, style, and approach. You own the solution from idea to publication. You do not wait for a task list. You analyze the site, find the opportunities, and execute the improvements that drive the biggest impact.

  • Strategic Content Architecture: You decide the format that converts. Sometimes an article is best, but often the customer needs a flow calculator, a comparison table, an upgraded category page, a tooltip, diagram, video, or a selection wizard. You will build the right content for the job to build our brand and convert users.

  • Technical Authority & Accuracy: You are responsible for the technical accuracy of all public-facing content. You must have high engineering knowledge to validate data, correct errors, and ensure our advice is sound. You are the filter that prevents AI hallucinations or inaccuracies from reaching the customer.

  • Build the Content Moat: You will create unique value that competitors and AI models cannot replicate. Go beyond text to produce proprietary assets like physical product benchmarks, expert interviews, and deep-dive technical diagrams or videos.

  • Optimize for the Audience: You will structure information to ensure our content ranks high for search engines, serves as a primary citation source for AI models, and provides clear, helpful guidance for humans (engineers, non-engineers, buyers, etc.).

  • Agile Adaptation: You will stay ahead of marketing trends and follow the data. If a content format stops working, you pivot. You track traffic and conversion metrics to continuously refine your strategy.

Requirements

What We Are Looking For

  • High Engineering Knowledge: You have a background in engineering, deep experience in technical industries, and can explain the physics of our products easily.

  • Builds With AI: You have designed and built content workflows using AI: research pipelines, structured drafting processes, automated publishing steps. You chose the tools, connected them, and own the quality of what comes out.

  • Outcome Owner: You are driven by results (traffic, conversion, revenue) rather than output (article or word count). You manage the roadmap and deliver end-to-end results.

  • Collaborative Investigator: You do not work in a silo. You actively partner with our Product and Operations teams to extract their internal expertise. You work with them and translate their knowledge into public-facing content that sets us apart from competitors.

  • Versatile Creator: You are comfortable switching formats and could work on writing a white paper, designing calculator logic, auditing category pages, and building dashboards to analyze results all in 1 week.

Why Choose Tameson?

  • Direct Business Impact: Your work directly correlates to sales. Publish the right guide and you can watch organic traffic and conversions move. There is a direct line between what you produce and company revenue.

  • Innovation: We are an aggressive, modern company. We want you to experiment with new formats, tools, and strategies.

  • Company culture: We value collaboration, professional growth, and fun. We regularly have company activities (online and offline) to stay connected and inspired.

  • Growth: We are scaling rapidly. As we expand, your professional opportunities grow.

Role Work Conditions

  • Employment type: Full time position (remote).

  • Working hours: Flexible work hours, with availability required Monday through Friday and a minimum overlap of 12:00–17:00 GMT+1.

  • Contract type: You will join as an independent contractor. To simplify hiring outside our registered countries, we engage global talent through freelance contracts.

Ready to define the future of industrial e-commerce?

If you have the technical mind to understand our products and the strategic mind to market them, apply today.

Highlights

Tameson seeks a remote Head of Technical Content to build authority, create expert content, and optimize for AI. Independent contractor role.

jobs.excerpt: Full-time contract position (Remote US-Based) $150,000 - $250,000 per annum (variable and uncapped) Job Summary Emerse, a dynamic Sales Consulting business, is searching for the next Sales Super Coach.
jobs.description:
Full-time contract position (Remote US-Based)

$150,000 - $250,000 per annum (variable and uncapped)

Job Summary

Emerse, a dynamic Sales Consulting business, is searching for the next Sales Super Coach. We’re looking for a dynamic and experienced sales leader or coach to join us as a Certified Sales Coach.

We are seeking a seasoned professional with proven sales experience and results, looking to transition into a coaching/consulting role, or an existing coach interested in helping business owners across the US, UK, and Europe smash their sales targets. On average, our coaches earn approximately $150,000 - $250,000 (variable and uncapped).

This role is a primarily remote role from anywhere in the US (with primarily eastern time work hours). Your purpose: embed lasting sales performance by applying proven strategies, building accountability, and delivering exceptional coaching experiences.

This is not your typical consultancy gig; it’s a chance to make a measurable difference every day.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Deliver high-impact coaching engagements using Emerse IP and methodology

  • Facilitate team bootcamps, strategy workshops, and performance reviews

  • Build and roll out client-specific sales playbooks

  • Support sales hiring and onboarding with clear standards and structure

  • Track performance and drive growth through diagnostics and KPIs

  • Collaborate with the Emerse team to develop new services and tools

Requirements

What You Bring – (Mandatory)

  • 10+ years in B2B sales and leadership roles.

  • Proven coaching or mentoring expertise.

  • A passion for elevating sales talent and client success.

  • Experience in sales, hiring, and team development.

  • Confidence working independently in a flexible, remote setup.

If you're currently self-employed or building a portfolio career, this could be the ideal next step with a values-led business.

How It Works

You will complete a 90-day certification and onboarding programme, equipping you with Emerse tools, training, and client frameworks. You’ll work on an outcome-based model—measured by results, not hours. You’ll earn a share of gross profit for each client engagement, plus sales commission for bringing in new business.

What You’ll Get

  • Uncapped earnings potential.

  • Remote, flexible working.

  • Travel expenses for in-person sessions covered.

Our Mission - Bringing Excellence to the Profession of Sales

At Emerse, we believe sales should be a respected, well-practised profession, not just a job. Based in London and Miami, we partner with ambitious B2B companies to drive revenue growth through rigorous evaluation, strategic playbook design, world-class coaching, and exceptional sales hiring.

Our Core Values

We are guided by five principles that shape everything we do:

  • Do the right thing

  • Think ahead

  • Communicate with clarity

  • Make an impact

  • Lead with high standard
